exposure: Time of artificial rupture of membranes (ARM)
Mode of delivery (spontaneous labor, induction of labor, elective caesarean section)
cohort: 30 pregnant women with supermorbid obesity (BMI >=50) who delivered at Rotherham General Hospital, United Kingdom, between January 2018 and December 2019
finding: The study found that a structured pathway for managing supermorbid obesity in pregnancy, including antenatal planning and postpartum care, was associated with generally good outcomes.
mod_finding: The proportion of women delivering out of hours was higher if ARM was later in the day.
